canvas.note: Pinned capture canvas: the bank's reference size. The tiling WM does NOT hold every client to one width (this session: wip 634, a11 420 in the same run), so window width is capture state, not a constant. capture.sh shot dies when a fresh shot's canvas differs from this pin; capture.sh bank dies when a fresh shot differs from the same-named banked PNG; run.sh diff asserts the two sides match each other. To run at a different size deliberately, resize the client AND update this pin plus the per-screen center rects together.

fixture.spawnSource: server log line: 'logged in with entity id N at (x, y, z)'
fixture.note: Fresh NORMAL world per side. Flag placed at the world spawn via the console command `_qtdev townplace <x> <y-1> <z>`; the townie spawned with `_qtdev townspawn <x> <y-1> <z>` (owner paths: TownFlags.register + SpawnVisitorReward.spawnNew). No tp across distance - a long tp desyncs client/server Y by ~64 in this box and kills the player; the death screen then gets captured as a 'screen'.
